views.reason: Pipeline atlas or preview sheet, not a placed physical object.

generation_parameters.prompt: Make a 6-column x 4-row transparent orthographic pixel-art atlas. Columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Rows exactly crystal-cluster, mushroom-cluster, waystone, treasure-altar matching reference order. Each cell one complete centered object. Keep exact source identity, shape, recognizable details, colors and proportions; consistent object between views. True orthographic views, top straight down and rear opposite front; infer hidden surfaces. No labels, scenery, ground plane, shadows, perspective, borders, grid marks. Crisp pixel art, transparent background.

provenance.notes: Unmodified raw generation retained for review and reproducibility.
